No city's belief benefited it except the people of Jonah: when they believed, the punishment of disgrace was removed from them and they were given enjoyment for a time.
The man of the fish left in anger, then called from the darknesses that there is no deity but Allah and he had done wrong; Allah answered and saved him.
Jonah fled to a ship, lost the lot, was swallowed by the fish, saved for exalting Allah, cast ashore ill, and sent to a hundred thousand or more, who believed.
Be patient for your Lord's decision, unlike Jonah, the companion of the fish, who called out in distress; his Lord's favor reached him, choosing him and making him righteous.
